notes.manas-2010:p1504:b001:l014: Heads as buckets of blood retained literally; no softened wound summary.
notes.manas-2010:p1504:b001:l020: Кандуу кан repetitive blood expression retained, not treated as an accidental duplicate.
notes.manas-2010:p1504:b001:l025: Мунетерин read as what would happen to them/do this to them; Kanykey’s foresight is explicit, without adding a vision scene.
notes.manas-2010:p1504:b001:l029: Күлазык long-keeping journey provisions, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/КҮЛ/. The following miraculous restoration belongs to this epic scene; no recipe or modern therapeutic claim added.
notes.manas-2010:p1504:b001:l030: Мээр чөп fabulous strength-restoring herb in2015 dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/meer-chop/. Not love potion here and no botanical species guessed.
notes.manas-2010:p1504:b001:l033: Кудус Jerusalem and Мысыр Egypt are the traditional place designations; no actual source of a modern medicine claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p1504:b001:l039: Мээрин кандыр- satisfy a person’s longing/need in Yudakhin мээр; not literally fill affection.
notes.manas-2010:p1504:b001:l041: Visible суутун read contextually as суусун thirst. Manas encyclopedia quotes this exact provision passage with суусун: https://el-sozduk.kg/kul-azyk-2/. Raw unchanged and correction expressly qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1505:b001:l002: Желмаян swift enduring riding/burden camel; no unsupported breed or separate person invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1505:b001:l015: Бук expresses pent-up inner force here; bursting with strength is contextual, not a claim the food creates a substance called buk.
notes.manas-2010:p1505:b001:l017: Ык ready/apt is contextual with the horse’s renewed vigor; exact compressed predication remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1505:b001:l020: Умачтай көзү ачыл- open eyes wide/become alert, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/умач/.
notes.manas-2010:p1505:b001:l041: All coursers die is the source’s sweeping battle hyperbole, retained although named mounts continue later.
notes.manas-2010:p1506:b001:l006: Children not yet of age is explicit, with no exact ages inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1506:b001:l012: Көктө stitch/tack: mending broken crupper straps here, not sprouting vegetation.
notes.manas-2010:p1506:b001:l023: Олок blind in one eye, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/олок/. Not a generic unnamed wound.
notes.manas-2010:p1506:b001:l024: Жаа bow used metonymically for its arrow; torn-off arms retained as the text’s violent image.
notes.manas-2010:p1506:b001:l032: Алакчы дүйнө deceptive/transient earthly world: https://el-sozduk.kg/алакчы/.
notes.manas-2010:p1506:b001:l035: Warriors rejoicing is the narrator’s judgment, contrasting cowardly distress in the next lines; not changed to universal mourning.
notes.manas-2010:p1507:b001:l029: Азирет Holy One, exact identity not established by this line alone.
notes.manas-2010:p1507:b001:l031: First-person plural салдык retained as the warriors’ own imagined accounting of their deeds; preceding clause’s omitted pronouns supplied accordingly.
notes.manas-2010:p1507:b001:l035: Becoming black donkeys ridden by dead Muslims is the explicit imagined afterlife penalty. Printed кылын contextually кылып, raw retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1508:b001:l015: Жалгыз көз one-eyed enemies retained literally; no generalized hostile epithet replaces the epic image.
notes.manas-2010:p1508:b001:l020: Чыпка куйрук matted tail;1969/2015 dictionary quotes Sarala’s exact epithet: https://el-sozduk.kg/чып/. Not filter-tail.
notes.manas-2010:p1508:b001:l025: Six thousand retained, without reconciling later counts of governors.
notes.manas-2010:p1508:b001:l034: Бучкак lower trouser/garment part; contemptuous hem comparison retained rather than generalizing to nobody.
notes.manas-2010:p1508:b001:l037: Looming corners/points describe the fortress in the next lines; no modern architectural reconstruction.
notes.manas-2010:p1509:b001:l008: Буй кыл- throw into confusion/distress: https://el-sozduk.kg/buy-9/.
notes.manas-2010:p1509:b001:l010: Round-headed humankind is the source epithet; no racial-anatomical explanation added.
notes.manas-2010:p1509:b001:l027: Right and left retained without deciding whether spatial sides or named tribal divisions are meant.
notes.manas-2010:p1509:b001:l030: Кан кожо translated holy khan as a title; this line alone does not securely establish a separate named character.
notes.manas-2010:p1509:b001:l034: Кайып unseen/supernatural source of the sword; no manufacture narrative inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1509:b001:l039: Жойболот romanized Zhoybolot; the six listed sword names are preserved as proper names, not omitted or substituted for owners.
notes.manas-2010:p1510:b001:l007: Possessor of Zhoybolot is Almambet, explicitly named at1510:l011 and in the preceding sword list; proximity of Kongurbay’s name does not transfer ownership.
notes.manas-2010:p1510:b001:l016: Left-handed stroke/rightward shot retained even in a sword passage; no weapon harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1510:b001:l022: Чунактар daredevils, familiar rough warrior epithet; not a literal claim of missing ears.
notes.manas-2010:p1510:b001:l025: About six thousand governors preserved as the epic count/title, not changed to ordinary soldiers.
notes.manas-2010:p1511:b001:l011: Right shoulder explicitly singular in the source, not silently broadened to both shoulders.
notes.manas-2010:p1511:b001:l016: Visible Амыз read as a reduced/corrupt намыс in намыс кылба do not feel shame, attested Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/namys/. Feigned-flight context supports this qualified restoration; no exact Амыз headword claimed, raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1511:b001:l026: Seven pierced together in one thrust retained literally.
notes.manas-2010:p1511:b001:l035: Yudakhin сап quotes this exact paired formula: weapon shaft slips from hand, heart loses its covering, terror as though heart bursts. https://el-sozduk.kg/САП/. Image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1511:b001:l039: Printed Бээжпндп visibly defective; Beijing read from repeated name/context, raw unaltered.
notes.manas-2010:p1512:b001:l014: Not worth his shin retains the disparaging body-part comparison.
notes.manas-2010:p1512:b001:l026: Dog’s fight retained literally. The precise idiomatic scale is uncertain; no invented dog combat event.
notes.manas-2010:p1512:b001:l027: Эт бышым time needed to cook meat, an approximate traditional duration; no minute count invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1512:b001:l032: Кең-Кол ата ancestral Keng-Kol; ата kept as ancestral honorific rather than creating an additional father character.
notes.manas-2010:p1513:b001:l001: Баштагысын карматып rendered more of the same, referring contextually to his former violent prowess. Exact ellipsis remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1513:b001:l011: Ritually marked thing is a euphemistic circumcision insult; the source’s emeng thing is preserved without expanding it into extra graphic anatomy.
notes.manas-2010:p1513:b001:l022: Teeth crumbling like millet retained as heroic fury hyperbole; not silently made chattering.
notes.manas-2010:p1513:b001:l037: Он талаа literally ten directions/open expanses; tears image and ten retained, not reduced to simply crying.
notes.manas-2010:p1514:b001:l013: A rope’s length is approximate, not converted to meters.
notes.manas-2010:p1514:b001:l016: Шор salt flat/marsh, with bogging horse explicit. No engineered trap structure beyond the text added.
notes.manas-2010:p1514:b001:l023: Pressure on the Chinese is retained before the subsequent arrival of reinforcements and their joy; no pronoun reversal.
notes.manas-2010:p1514:b001:l025: Керик rhinoceros as fabulous ridden mount retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1514:b001:l029: Agayar named as Almambet’s former fellow pupil and Chinese combatant. Same written name occurs elsewhere among Manas’s companions; this batch does not silently resolve that narrative inconsistency.
notes.manas-2010:p1515:b001:l015: Karykan is visibly the ruler named here; not substituted with Esenkan or Kongurbay.
notes.manas-2010:p1515:b001:l031: Six thousand perish after six thousand arrive, followed by six survivors: all printed numbers retained without arithmetic repair.
notes.manas-2010:p1515:b001:l035: Казыналык refers to treasury/state service; marksman retained, no invented personal name or exact office grade.
notes.manas-2010:p1516:b001:l007: Sideways movement and changed cap/green clothes preserved; no unstated camouflage technology added.
notes.manas-2010:p1516:b001:l011: Five praise lines refer to Bokmurun, named at1516:l021. The intervening Chinese movement interrupts their syntax, retained in source order.
notes.manas-2010:p1516:b001:l020: Кызыталак harsh insult rendered bastard, preserving the narrator’s register.
notes.manas-2010:p1516:b001:l025: Кылагар көз barely open, wandering eyes of a dying person; Yudakhin quotes the paired eyes/moustache formula: https://el-sozduk.kg/кыл/.
notes.manas-2010:p1516:b001:l031: Kongurbay is the nearest overt subject of scattering Chinese ranks. The abrupt agency remains qualified; no silent transfer of this clause to Syrgak.
notes.manas-2010:p1516:b001:l033: Томуктай knucklebone-sized belittling image, not an actual measurement of Syrgak.
notes.manas-2010:p1516:b001:l042: Сыр бараң lacquered musket, a firearm description; not treated as an unknown personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p1517:b001:l001: Аяр sorcerer designation for Agayar in this scene, not an additional unnamed man. Agayar is named in the next aiming formula.
notes.manas-2010:p1517:b001:l003: Маша/машаа firearm hammer, with ирме- firing action, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/маша/.
notes.manas-2010:p1517:b001:l012: Күн in the thunder/weather expression is rendered storm rather than an invented roaring solar body.
notes.manas-2010:p1517:b001:l015: Black hat brim literal epithet, as in1372 batch and the Kyrgyz Semetey1959 parallel; not a Karakalpak ethnic identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1517:b001:l035: Өң жаман poor/inferior fighters in contrast with foremost; no added claim about skin color.
notes.manas-2010:p1518:b001:l014: Kögala assigned here to rescued Kökchö, yet immediately afterward and later to Chubak. Printed horse name retained at every occurrence; no harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1518:b001:l019: Akbaltay and earlier Baltay preserved as the established name variants of Chubak’s father.
notes.manas-2010:p1518:b001:l040: Kögala is again the mount at hand although Chubak is dismounted. His mount is supplied contextually; raw астында retained in source and not used to assert a new rider.
notes.manas-2010:p1519:b001:l024: Көйкашка outstanding/renowned, primary glossary finding https://el-sozduk.kg/koy-12/. Not an untranslated rank or new proper name.
notes.manas-2010:p1519:b001:l030: Falcon comparison retained; the precise subject of the birdlike start/swoop remains compressed in the causative.
notes.manas-2010:p1520:b001:l002: Printed Керки adze follows Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/КЕРКИ/. Could be a displaced/corrupt керик rhinoceros form, but no silent change is made; weapon reading remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1520:b001:l039: Forty companions are occupied in separate fights; locked in slaughter does not assert all forty have already died.
notes.manas-2010:p1521:b001:l010: Inexhaustible enemy flaring up as they seem depleted is source hyperbole, retained with its repetitions.
notes.manas-2010:p1521:b001:l037: Өлсөмчү/көрсөмчү optative forms rendered let me die/suffer after the wish for Manas’s presence. A rhetorical would I then suffer reading is also possible; no certainty claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p1522:b001:l002: Tiken supplied as speaker of shoot Chubak, because the previous subject Chubak would otherwise misleadingly seem to order his own shooting. Source leaves the subject implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p1522:b001:l018: Тобокел trust/risk oneself to fate; no untranslated whole utterance left in the English count.
notes.manas-2010:p1522:b001:l020: Чубакелеп name-cry verb rendered crying Chubak’s name; no fabricated additional repetition.
notes.manas-2010:p1522:b001:l032: Belt edge, lung/heart area and saddle bow are the three printed aiming references. No modern instructional anatomy is inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1522:b001:l039: Калкан shield on the head is visibly printed. Not silently replaced with туулга helmet.
notes.manas-2010:p1523:b001:l007: Дүлөй of the heart is atrium in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/дүлөй/, rendered upper chamber. Жүлүн marrow retained literally even though heart anatomy is unusual; no invented nerve or vessel precision.
notes.manas-2010:p1523:b001:l020: Боз ала кызыл туу retained as pale mottled/red banners. Punctuation and exact division of colors are uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1523:b001:l032: Karykan commands all to perish; retained without softening to fight bravely.
notes.manas-2010:p1523:b001:l038: Two successive day-rest phrases preserved; second күн not silently changed to түн night.
